title: A bacterial transcription activator dedicated to the expression of the enzyme catalyzing the first committed step in fatty acid biosynthesis.
authors: Xu, Yuanyou; Lin, Zihan; Hou, Jiyuan; Ye, Kai; Han, Sirui; Liang, Yuxuan; Liang, Huihui; Wu, Shihua; Tao, Yizhi J; Gao, Haichun
one_liner_zh: 该文鉴定并表征细菌转录因子AccR对accS启动子的结合与调控，含分子对接和晶体结构分析，但核心为实验生物学发现，AI/物理模拟方法仅辅助，非TF-DNA互作建模核心。
abstract: Acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACCase) catalyzes the first committed and rate-limiting step of de novo fatty acid synthesis (FAS). Although this step is tightly regulated, regulators that specifically control transcription of the ACCase genes remain elusive. In this study, we identified LysR-type transcriptional regulator AccR as a dedicated activator for the transcription of accS, a gene encoding a multiple-domain ACCase in Shewanella oneidensis. We showed that AccR interacts with the accS promoter in vivo in response to changes in acetyl-CoA levels and in vitro. Analysis of the crystal structure of the effector-binding domain (EBD) of AccR identified two potential ligand-binding pockets, one of which is likely to bind acetyl-CoA as a ligand based on results from molecular docking, direct binding assay and mutational analysis of the residues predicted to interact with acetyl-CoA. Despite this, the interaction between AccR and acetyl-CoA alone appears unstable, implying that an additional yet unknown ligand is required for activation of AccR. Furthermore, we showed that AccR is acetylated, but the modification may not be critical for sensing acetyl-CoA. Overall, our data substantiate the existence of a dedicated transcriptional regulator for ACCases, expanding our current understanding of the regulation of FAS.
abstract_zh: 乙酰辅酶A羧化酶（ACCase）催化从头脂肪酸合成（FAS）的第一个关键且限速步骤。尽管该步骤受到严格调控，但特异性控制ACCase基因转录的调控因子仍不明确。在本研究中，我们鉴定出LysR型转录调控因子AccR作为Shewanella oneidensis中编码多结构域ACCase的基因accS转录的专一性激活因子。我们证明AccR在体内响应乙酰辅酶A水平变化而与accS启动子相互作用，并在体外也观察到该相互作用。对AccR效应子结合结构域（EBD）的晶体结构分析鉴定出两个潜在的配体结合口袋，其中一个可能以乙酰辅酶A为配体，这一结论基于分子对接、直接结合实验以及对预测与乙酰辅酶A相互作用的残基进行突变分析的结果。尽管如此，AccR与乙酰辅酶A单独之间的相互作用似乎不稳定，暗示需要一种额外的未知配体来激活AccR。此外，我们显示AccR被乙酰化，但该修饰可能对感知乙酰辅酶A并非关键。总体而言，我们的数据证实了ACCase存在专一性转录调控因子，扩展了当前对FAS调控的理解。
